requirements.checkable: createRaffle deploys an ERC-1167 clone of raffleImplementation, initializes it, registers it in raffleById, idByRaffle, and isRaffle, transfers the prize NFT into it, and verifies prize ownership and Active status within one atomic transaction.
requirements.quote: Atomically creates, funds, and registers autonomous fixed-implementation raffle clones.

requirements.checkable: raffleImplementation, quoteToken, protocolTreasury, and vrfWrapper are declared immutable, and callbackGasLimit, requestConfirmations, and fee constants in RaffleConstants are declared constant with no mutating functions.
requirements.quote: The implementation, canonical six-decimal USDC, treasury, fee, and Chainlink configuration are immutable.

requirements.checkable: RaffleFactory defines no owner or admin role, no pause state or modifier, no upgrade or implementation-replacement path, no asset rescue function, and no setter for protocol configuration.
requirements.quote: The factory has no owner, pause, upgrade, rescue, or mutable protocol configuration.

requirements.checkable: RaffleFactory's constructor sets quoteToken, vrfWrapper, and protocolTreasury once, deploys a new Raffle(quoteToken_, vrfWrapper_) implementation whose constructor locks initialization (initialized = true, status = Status.Refunding), and stores it in the immutable raffleImplementation.
requirements.quote: Deploys the ownerless factory and its locked raffle implementation with one immutable configuration.

requirements.checkable: The RaffleFactory constructor calls IERC20Metadata(quoteToken_).decimals() and reverts with UnsupportedQuoteToken(quoteToken_) if the call fails or InvalidQuoteTokenDecimals(quoteDecimals, 6) if the returned value is not 6.
requirements.quote: The quote token must report exactly six decimals

requirements.checkable: The RaffleFactory constructor calls _requireContract(quoteToken_) and _requireContract(vrfWrapper_), reverting with NotContract if either address has code.length == 0.
requirements.quote: the wrapper and quote token must contain deployed code.

requirements.checkable: Off-chain deployment constraint that cannot be verified from Solidity contract code alone: the constructor only checks code.length > 0 and decimals() == 6 on quoteToken_.
requirements.quote: Deployment tooling must supply and verify the target chain's official USDC address because the constructor cannot prove token identity from metadata.

requirements.checkable: The constructor stores quoteToken_ in the immutable quoteToken and passes it to new Raffle(quoteToken_, vrfWrapper_) so every raffle clone shares the same immutable quoteToken.
requirements.quote: Target chain's official six-decimal USDC contract trusted by every raffle.

requirements.checkable: The constructor stores vrfWrapper_ in the immutable vrfWrapper and passes it to new Raffle(quoteToken_, vrfWrapper_) so every raffle clone uses the same immutable VRF v2.5 wrapper.
requirements.quote: Official Chainlink VRF v2.5 native direct-funding wrapper for the target chain.

requirements.checkable: The constructor rejects zero or unsafe protocol destinations (address(this), quoteToken_, vrfWrapper_, implementation) for protocolTreasury_, stores it in the immutable protocolTreasury, and createRaffle passes it to every clone's initialize call.
requirements.quote: Immutable protocol-fee recipient used by every raffle.

requirements.checkable: createRaffle deploys a fresh ERC-1167 clone of raffleImplementation and calls IRaffle(raffle).initialize(...), which sets initialized = true and reverts with AlreadyInitialized on any subsequent call.
requirements.quote: The fresh fixed-target clone can initialize only once

requirements.checkable: createRaffle carries the nonReentrant modifier and validates endTime > block.timestamp and saleDuration <= MAX_SALE_DURATION, clones and initializes the raffle, registers it, transfers the prize via safeTransferFrom, and reverts with PrizeEscrowVerificationFailed unless prize.ownerOf(prizeTokenId) == raffle and status() == Active.
requirements.quote: this function is nonReentrant and atomic.

requirements.checkable: Before Clones.clone is called in createRaffle, _validateCreateParams verifies params.prizeToken has deployed code and is not an unsafe protocol destination (address(this), quoteToken, vrfWrapper, raffleImplementation, or isRaffle[params.prizeToken]), reverting with NotContract or UnsafeProtocolDestination.
requirements.quote: Validates the sponsor-selected token, recipient, reserve, and supported ERC-721 interface before cloning.

requirements.checkable: Before Clones.clone is called in createRaffle, _validateCreateParams verifies params.sponsorRecipient is not address(0) and is not an unsafe protocol destination (address(this), quoteToken, vrfWrapper, params.prizeToken, raffleImplementation, or isRaffle[params.sponsorRecipient]), reverting with ZeroAddress or UnsafeProtocolDestination.
requirements.quote: Validates the sponsor-selected token, recipient, reserve, and supported ERC-721 interface before cloning.

requirements.checkable: Before Clones.clone is called in createRaffle, _validateCreateParams verifies params.reserveEntries != 0 and reverts with ZeroReserveEntries() when params.reserveEntries == 0.
requirements.quote: Validates the sponsor-selected token, recipient, reserve, and supported ERC-721 interface before cloning.

requirements.checkable: Before Clones.clone is called in createRaffle, _validateCreateParams calls IERC165(params.prizeToken).supportsInterface(type(IERC721).interfaceId) in a try/catch and reverts with UnsupportedPrizeToken(params.prizeToken) if the call reverts or returns false.
requirements.quote: Validates the sponsor-selected token, recipient, reserve, and supported ERC-721 interface before cloning.

requirements.checkable: _requireContract(address account) checks account.code.length == 0 and reverts with NotContract(account) when the address has no deployed code.
requirements.quote: Reverts unless an address contains deployed code.
